executive_summary: Freeze information-source audit gates before any source ranking; never evaluate forecasts.
protected_parent_models: V5.1/R2/T0Ridge, all historical model code/tests and results
pre_outcome_rule: Original publication availability, not measurement/survey response date; date-only sources get23:59:59local upperbound and compare to preceding weekday16:00America/New_York; no guessed holiday releases.
PIT: A=exact historical field vintage plus actual release proof; B=original released field/date reconstructible with correction audit; C=minor documented revisions/current history diagnostic only; D=unreconstructible reject
history_gate: At least8years accepted coverage and overlap>=3of2010-13,2014-17,2018-20,2021-24; sample-based feasibility remains conditional on full manifest acquisition
novelty_gate: HIGH/MEDIUM, not same tested features/source; source gate failures are not predictive failures
ranking: Descending data-quality score; ties use preferred source family then stable source ID. No future outcomes or T0Ridge result used in ranking.
selected_primary: Exactly first eligible fixed ranking candidate, or NONE if none passes; no forced selection
submission_gate: Always false for INFO01; future source-specific legal/data and per-task cutoff approval required
small_probe: At most3historical snapshots per serious source, plus documentation/indexes; no full raw panel or target labels; ordinary authentic public access only
raw_preservation: Hash original bytes only after actual download; web extracted inspections are explicitly a different representation and never claimed original byte hashes; private copies only where permitted
independence: No target access or scoring; reused2001–2024ledger and24cards exposed;2025incident means not clean; unidentified sealed data never accessed
LOCATION02: Only a frozen draft, no execution or training
